candidate._doc: Pre-filter applied while collecting, BEFORE any verification. Tier is chosen by the live (discounted) price. A deal must clear both the money floor and the claimed-% floor of its tier. Cheap items need a big %, expensive items need real money.

verdict._doc: Applied after verification against KanBkam history or a same-model market price. A deal is ok when the REAL discount clears okMin, OR when it clears warnMin and the real money saved clears its price-band floor.
verdict._ownHistory: Rows with no KanBkam record (fashion, beauty, baby, furniture) are re-judged against data/history.json — prices this pipeline observed itself — once we have at least ownHistoryMinDays distinct earlier days.

page._maxNewPerRun: Hard cap on rows added in a single run. Raised 60 -> 150 on 22 Sep (with maxRows 420 -> 900) when the rendered collectors opened Almanea's and Blackbox's full National Day catalogues. Highest verified saving wins; the rest are picked up by the next run.
page._reservedPerChip: Added 2026-09-22. apply.js new fills these chips FIRST (best verified saving within each chip), then ranks everything left together as before. Without it a TV wins every intake slot on money saved and the page stays electronics + furniture.
page._maxPerChip: Added 2026-09-22. Render-time cap in build.js: at most N rows per chip are shown. Furniture had 44 rows of which 3 were verified-good; verified and available rows are kept first, na and unavailable rows are hidden first. Nothing is deleted from state.

discovery._doc: Added 22 Nov 2026 (Mahmoud approved the review «selection, volume and sorting»). The run reads these numbers here; RUNBOOK §2 and the task prompt carry no numbers of their own.
discovery._ceiling: A ceiling, never a quota. Raised for the KanBkam-tracked stores on 22 Nov: at 20:36 on 21 Nov Amazon had 86 candidates with a recorded price at least 5% above today's and 18 got in.
discovery.brandRule: The listing names a brand (the store's brand field, or the first word of its English title or slug) and the store shows reviews or ratings for it. Generic or unbranded listings are dropped. How famous the brand is is NOT a test: it says nothing about whether the discount is real.
discovery._emptyChipsFirst: Shortlist from the categories of chips that have no verified row (toys, sports, perfume, personal care, kids) before the rest; rules.page.reservedPerChip then keeps their slots at intake.

rotation._doc: node scripts/rotation.js prints which market store and which no-record store this run works on. Market: one per slot (08:21 saco, 12:21 jarir, 16:21 almanea, 20:21 blackbox). No-record stores: one per run in turn, branded items only, checked against Amazon/noon through rules/match.js with size and capacity.

discovery._budget: Runs took about 15 of 55 minutes on 21-22 Nov. Discovery stops at minute 40 so the check and the publish always fit. Watch plan usage: the usage limit stopped a refresh on 20 Nov 21:45.
